summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of monthly net revenues for May 2026. The filing reports consolidated net revenues of NT$63,033 million (US$2,001 million), up 1.3% sequential and 28.6% YoY. ATM assembly, testing and material revenues were NT$42,162 million (US$1,338 million), up 4.1% sequential and 37.9% YoY. This is a routine earnings disclosure under Taiwan regulatory requirements, containing forward-looking statements but no transaction, corporate action, or special situation. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are mentioned.
